title: Wat Phra That Choeng Chum
scope: The white masonry Phra That Choeng Chum stupa with its gilt spire and the adjoining four-gabled viharn immediately east.
limitations: The exterior model covers the standing stupa and its photographed eastern viharn. The older separate ordination hall and wider compound are outside this asset scope.
The spire divisions, relief work and ceramic roof ornaments use photographic proportions.
